basic_info.description: Within steps of the Enchanted Palace of Fine Arts sits this remarkable 4BR/3BA multi-level home featuring a large west-facing L/R & offering GG Bridge views, period details, a classic marble faced wb fireplace, hand carved cabinetry, sconces & rich hardwoodd floors. Natural light accents the FDR from an adjacent patio/deck, beside an open Chef's Kitchen which features dbl ovens, gas cook top, hand-painted tile, custom cabinetry, skylight & pantry. The lot boasts 3,724 sq. ft. w/incredible indoor/outdoor living space, including a huge deck off the main rear bedrooms. The top floor offers a primary suite w/WIC, full bath Cityscape & GGB views. Then, get ready to have some FUN in the entertainment room on the ground level, complete w/ guest room, full bath & an authentic wood bar w/brass rail. This great room is the perfect escape for family & friends & opens out to a large landscaped garden w/fresh vegetable/fruit plants + a historical Kezar Stadium ticket booth!  Extra storage space, laundry area/utility sink & 2 car tandem parking. All within a short distance to The Presidio, Marina Green, Crissy Field & Chestnut St. which offers a variety of boutiques, restaurants, specialty markets, fitness clubs, transportation & more! A MUST See  Don't let this be the ONE that got away!
